items.title: I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
items.author: Dominic-Madori Davis
items.content: <article>After obtaining an interactive avatar and training it to discuss venture fraud, I have mixed feelings about making AI clones of ourselves. </article>

items.title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
items.author: Lucas Ropek
items.content: <article>The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses.  </article>

items.title: Crusoe abandons $1.25B plan to use Boom turbines at AI data centers
items.author: Kirsten Korosec
items.content: <article>Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl said the company's new stationary power plants were no longer in Crusoe's near-term plans.</article>

items.title: Automattic has a new board after failed attempt to put CEO on leave
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>After days of upheaval at Automattic, following a failed attempt to remove CEO Matt Mullenweg, the company has a new board. </article>

items.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
items.author: Tim Fernholz
items.content: <article>AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge. </article>

items.title: Meta opens early access program for new Muse features
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>Anyone interested in joining has to ask Muse to put them on the list. </article>

items.title: The hottest new hangout for middle schoolers is NPR’s comment section?
items.author: Connie Loizos
items.content: <article>When NPR staffers flagged strange comments under their podcasts on Spotify as bots, it took a Gen Z colleague to (immediately) figure out the mystery.</article>

items.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
items.author: Aditya Mehta
items.content: <article>Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.</article>

items.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
items.author: TechCrunch Events
items.content: <article>Mark Wahlberg joins Bruce K. Lee at Disrupt to discuss investing, entrepreneurship, healthcare, wellness, and building businesses.</article>

items.title: Ahead of US IPO, British AI neocloud Nscale secures $3.36B in convertible financing
items.author: Marina Temkin
items.content: <article>The funding, which comes from Third Point, Nvidia, and others, will  fuel the company's massive AI data center buildout.</article>

items.title: The Aeropod automates soil aeration without robotics — see it at TechCrunch Disrupt
items.author: Tim De Chant
items.content: <article>Muju Earth Technologies has developed a deceptively simply pod that can save farmers money while improving crop yields.</article>

items.title: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing reams of people’s data to the web
items.author: Zack Whittaker
items.content: <article>The findings highlight how AI-generated and vibe-coded apps can spill and expose users' data when not configured or secured properly.</article>

items.title: Astra and Opus just passed Turing’s other test
items.author: Tim Fernholz
items.content: <article>Frontier AI models are finishing Alan Turing's World War II codebreaking work. </article>

items.title: Meta is putting its muscle behind Muse as the AI app takes off
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>Muse is topping the app store charts and adding users at a rapid clip, while Meta ramps up the personal AI agent's promotion across its own apps and beyond.</article>

items.title: Meta’s AI Tamagotchi bet is…working?
items.author: Theresa Loconsolo
items.content: <article>When AI leaders at OpenAI and Anthropic started talking about “pacing the frontier,” maybe someone should have asked: what pace? Now it’s turned into model drop week for both companies as Anthropic rolled out Opus 5.5, followed by OpenAI’s GPT-6 model updates just 90 minutes later. But the company that stole the spotlight was Meta, whose personal AI agent Muse is reportedly outpacing ChatGPT’s early numbers and is headed for smart glasses and […]</article>

items.title: Kiteworks urges customers to shut down their servers amid ‘imminent’ threat of cyberattack
items.author: Zack Whittaker
items.content: <article>The tech giant, which allows companies to send large datasets over the internet, said it received a "credible threat" from law enforcement about an imminent attack.</article>

items.title: For months, OpenAI’s agent swarms have been attacking online databases to find obscure facts
items.author: Tim Fernholz
items.content: <article>The latest unauthorized agent swarms were discovered by researchers.</article>

items.title: Anthropic’s founders seek voting control ahead of IPO
items.author: Connie Loizos
items.content: <article>Anthropic is asking its shareholders to approve a structure that would give its seven co-founders a combined 50.1% of the vote on most corporate matters.</article>

items.title: Tesla finally moves to electrify trucking after a decade of work and delays
items.author: Sean O'Kane
items.content: <article>Tesla's Semi truck, with a 500-mile range, is about to hit the road in big numbers, with the company saying it plans to make 50,000 units a year.</article>

items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Ricursive Intelligence’s Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini on when AI starts designing its own hardware
items.author: TechCrunch Events
items.content: <article>At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Ricursive Intelligence co-founders Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini will take the Disrupt Stage to discuss closing the loop between AI and chip development. Save up to $200 on your pass before today ends.</article>
